records.title: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Cultural Exchange Scholarship Scheme (ICCR)
Rotary Peace Fellowship
records.deadline_display: Applications are submitted online to The Rotary Foundation and the global deadline is 15 May. The official application timeline states: "The 2027-28 Rotary Peace Fellowship application is now closed. The 2028-29 Rotary Peace Fellowship application will be available online in February 2027."
records.application_period: Annual cycle. Applications open in February and close 15 May; the 2027-28 cycle is closed and the 2028-29 cycle opens in February 2027.

records.title: Sapienza University of Rome Scholarships
records.deadline_display: The official Scholarships page publishes no single deadline. It states that for grants for students experiencing difficulties "The call for applications is usually published in September" and that "Scholarships and awards are granted throughout the year".
records.application_period: Rolling portfolio of calls across the year; specific calls open and close on their own published dates, with the September call noted for students in difficulty.

records.title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (JSP)
records.official_source: Asian Development Bank (financed by the Government of Japan)
records.deadline_display: No single ADB deadline; applications go to a designated institution at least six months before the intended start of studies
records.application_period: Rolling, institution-led: ADB instructs applicants to send applications at least six months prior to the planned commencement of studies, so a 2027 start can be applied for now
